source.storyText:
A little brown insect crawls laboriously from one corner of my cement heavy terrace to another. I wonder what thoughts it [thinks], what are its goals and aspirations, its dreams and disappointments, its friends and enemies.

I check my email, a friendly notice from the county pops up. “Vacuuming or squashing nymphs are the easiest way to reduce the population of spotted lanternfly, without using pesticide,” it said.

project.title: A Little Brown Insect Crosses the Terrace
project.visualStyle: Cinematic animated film with realistic insect locomotion, subtly expressive body language, shallow-depth macro photography, polished natural lighting, and a restrained gray, brown, moss-green, and muted teal palette. Maintain coherent terrace geography and scale. No visible writing, captions, logos, or readable interface text.

entities.name: Little Lanternfly Nymph
entities.visualDescription: Tiny brown-black nymph with faint cream speckles, six slender legs, short antennae, a segmented oval body, and slightly dusty wingless shell; movements are slow, deliberate, and physically effortful.
entities.continuityNotes: Keep identical body proportions, cream speckle pattern, dusty shell, and hesitant gait across all terrace scenes.

entities.name: Terrace Observer
entities.visualDescription: Adult seen only through medium-brown hands and forearms, with short clean nails and a muted teal cotton sleeve; movements are calm and curious.
entities.continuityNotes: Never reveal the observer's face; preserve the medium-brown hands, short nails, and muted teal sleeve.

entities.name: Raised Concrete Seam
entities.visualDescription: A low rough ridge in the pale gray terrace concrete.
entities.continuityNotes: Keep its position fixed along the established terrace route.

entities.name: Terrace Pebble
entities.visualDescription: A small irregular gray-brown pebble beside a patch of moss.
entities.continuityNotes: Keep the same shape, scale, and position in scenes two and four.

entities.name: Laptop
entities.visualDescription: A slim laptop with a softly glowing screen and abstract unreadable interface symbols.
entities.continuityNotes: Show no readable text, brands, or logos.

entities.name: Compact Vacuum Nozzle
entities.visualDescription: A compact dark vacuum nozzle sized realistically against the observer’s hand.
entities.continuityNotes: Keep its shape and scale stable as it approaches the insect.

locations.name: Urban Terrace Route
locations.visualDescription: A weathered urban terrace with pale gray cement, hairline cracks, scattered grit, a tiny moss patch, a small pebble, and distant soft-focus planters.
locations.continuityNotes: Maintain a coherent route from the shaded corner toward the sunlit planters.

locations.name: Table at the Terrace Door
locations.visualDescription: A small table just inside an open terrace door, with the established concrete terrace and planters visible beyond.
locations.continuityNotes: Preserve the doorway, table, terrace geography, and daylight direction.

narration.text: A little brown insect crawls laboriously from one corner of my cement heavy terrace to another.

visual.summary: The tiny nymph struggles across a broad expanse of rough concrete.
visual.settingDescription: A weathered urban terrace with pale gray cement, hairline cracks, scattered grit, and distant soft-focus planters.

actions.description: The nymph slowly hauls itself over the raised concrete seam.
Its legs slip once before it regains purchase and continues.

camera.subject: the lanternfly nymph
camera.description: Ground-level extreme macro tracking beside the insect, moving steadily from the shaded corner toward the open terrace.

look.lighting: Soft morning sun cuts across cool shade, catching dust and the nymph's cream speckles.

visual.continuityNotes: Show the tiny brown-black nymph with cream speckles, six slender legs, short antennae, dusty wingless shell, and hesitant gait; establish travel from the shaded corner toward the sunlit planters.

narration.text: I wonder what thoughts it [thinks], what are its goals and aspirations, its dreams and disappointments, its friends and enemies.

visual.summary: The nymph climbs a pebble as the terrace becomes a vast, uncertain world around it.
visual.settingDescription: The same terrace route near a tiny moss patch, with a warm planter ahead and blurred ant shapes moving far behind.

actions.description: The nymph climbs to the pebble’s crest.
It pauses, searches with its antennae, and leans toward the distant planter.

camera.movement: slow orbit from behind to front
camera.subject: the lanternfly nymph
camera.description: Slow macro orbit from behind to a low frontal close-up, keeping the insect dominant while the immense terrace falls out of focus.

look.lighting: Warm sunlight rims the shell while long, soft shadows suggest both shelter and danger.

visual.continuityNotes: Preserve the nymph's brown-black body, cream speckles, six slender legs, short antennae, dusty shell, and hesitant gait; it remains on the established route toward the planters.

transitionIn.description: Rack focus from the nymph's searching antennae to a softly glowing laptop beyond the terrace doorway.

narration.text: I check my email, a friendly notice from the county pops up.

visual.summary: The observer checks a new civic notification on a laptop.
visual.settingDescription: A small table just inside the open terrace door, with the same concrete and planters visible beyond.

actions.description: The observer taps the laptop trackpad and opens an abstract civic notification with no readable text.

camera.subject: the observer’s hand and laptop
camera.description: Over-the-shoulder close shot with a gentle push toward the screen; all interface elements remain symbolic and unreadable.

look.lighting: Balanced daylight from the terrace mixes with a soft warm glow from the laptop.

visual.continuityNotes: Show only the observer's medium-brown hand, short clean nails, and muted teal sleeve; the same terrace remains visible outside, with no readable text or recognizable logos.

transitionIn.description: The camera pushes through the notification's simple insect pictogram into a matching macro view of the real terrace.

narration.text: “Vacuuming or squashing nymphs are the easiest way to reduce the population of spotted lanternfly, without using pesticide,” it said.

visual.summary: A vacuum nozzle advances toward the same nymph on the concrete.
visual.settingDescription: The established terrace route beside the pebble and moss patch, now viewed from just above ground level.

actions.description: The observer lowers the compact vacuum nozzle toward the motionless nymph, stopping inches above it.
The nymph remains still except for a small twitch of its antennae.

camera.subject: the nymph and descending nozzle
camera.description: Slow lateral dolly placing the nymph in sharp foreground and the descending nozzle as an enlarging dark shape behind it.

look.lighting: Sunlight is partially blocked by the nozzle, casting a cool shadow over the insect while the planter remains warmly lit ahead.

visual.continuityNotes: Use the same brown-black nymph with cream speckles, six slender legs, short antennae, and dusty shell beside the established pebble; the observer retains medium-brown hands, short nails, and muted teal sleeve.

transitionIn.description: Hold on the tiny nymph beneath the looming nozzle, then fade to black before contact.
